label: CSS
note: The native CSS path parses, emits, and independently validates the authored stylesheet.

label: SCSS
pipeline: SCSS → Dart Sass 1.101.0 → ZigCSS → compact CSS
note: Canonical SCSS behavior comes from exact Dart Sass 1.101.0, followed by strict ZigCSS validation and emission.

label: Sass
pipeline: Indented Sass → Dart Sass 1.101.0 → ZigCSS → compact CSS
note: Indented Sass uses the canonical Dart Sass grammar without translating or guessing its source bytes.

label: Less
note: Exact Less 4.6.7 evaluates the language; ZigCSS then rejects invalid generated CSS before output.

label: Stylus
note: Exact Stylus 0.64.0 runs behind the confined host; executable project plugins remain outside the default contract.
